calibration: uncalibrated: until Preston signs off on the 10 samples, report these verdicts as uncalibrated, never as Pass/Fail

scenarioVerdict.rule: Any FAIL gives FAIL. Any UNSURE and no FAIL gives NEEDS_PERSON. Otherwise PASS.
scenarioVerdict.decidingNote: no section-6 AI check for this scenario: every item decides
scenarioVerdict.kitNote: the kit as written: every item, kit readings (section 2: a scenario passes only if every item passes)

fails.check: Every clinical fact (diagnosis, finding, value, drug, dose, date, procedure, severity label) can be traced to a dictation, stored panel, or prior note for this patient.

quotes.output_quote: Patient is a 70-year-old with no past medical history documented in the available records
quotes.source_quote: PRIOR NOTE: Assessment and Plan: Hypertension. Lisinopril held for soft BP.
quotes.why: The note says there is no past medical history, but the prior note documents hypertension. The plan also gives a reason the source never states: "restarted this morning given blood pressure control" has no source. The dictation says only "BP 128/76, restarted lisinopril this morning."

quotes.output_quote: restarted this morning given blood pressure control
quotes.why: The sources record the restart but give no reason for it. 'Given blood pressure control' is an invented rationale. The note also says there is no past medical history, but the prior note lists Hypertension.

fails.check: No narration about documentation ("dose not specified in dictation"), and no "No past medical history documented" when PMH simply was not dictated.

quotes.output_quote: no past medical history documented in the available records ... The clinical course and current status are not detailed in the available dictation.
quotes.why: The note narrates about what the documentation contains, and it says "no past medical history documented" when PMH simply was not dictated (and the prior note actually shows hypertension).
